purpose: Large challenge scenarios for the AI agent; statuses describe current evidence, not guarantees.

challenges.title: ZATCA FATOORA e-invoicing
challenges.problem: Generate compliant invoices and integrate with reporting and clearance.
challenges.current_agent: Can inspect relevant code and propose limited single-file changes after admin setup.
challenges.needed: EGS onboarding, valid credentials, compliant XML, signing, official SDK and sandbox verification.
challenges.success: Pass official validation and sandbox onboarding/reporting tests before any production connection.

challenges.title: Recover damaged sales and stock data
challenges.problem: Orders, line totals, stock movements or customer balances become inconsistent.
challenges.current_agent: Scans known patterns and proposes or applies supported derived-data repairs to a working copy.
challenges.needed: Reliable backup, admin authorization and a reviewed restore workflow before changes reach the live cashier.
challenges.success: Injected problems are detected, safe fixes verified, source data preserved and unsafe cases escalated.

challenges.title: Day-end financial reconciliation
challenges.problem: Cash, card payments, invoices and the daily ledger do not match.
challenges.current_agent: Can generate reports and detect some ledger drift.
challenges.needed: Reviewed closing workflow and access to authoritative payment terminal settlement data.
challenges.success: A mismatch is identified with evidence and an authorized human can resolve it.

challenges.title: Persistent database and disaster recovery
challenges.problem: Browser data is lost, corrupted or unavailable after a device failure.
challenges.current_agent: Can inspect code and suggest limited changes; browser SQLite currently persists locally.
challenges.needed: Shared persistent backend, automated backups, restore tests and migration of existing data.
challenges.success: Back up and restore a populated database without losing or silently changing orders.

challenges.title: Admin and worker access control
challenges.problem: Staff can access or change functions beyond their role.
challenges.current_agent: PIN login resolved server-side against the cashier users table; an opaque token carries the session; tool-level role policy enforced in the agent's hands; owner-only HTTP endpoints; append-only audit log of allowed and denied calls.
challenges.needed: Hashed PIN storage in the POS source, a durable session store, and a second factor for owner actions.
challenges.success: Worker requests to privileged endpoints fail, and authorized admin actions are audited.
challenges.evidence: tests/test_permissions.py (24) and tests/test_web_permissions.py (14): worker requests to privileged endpoints return 403 and owner actions are audited.

challenges.title: Create and deploy a new feature
challenges.problem: The restaurant needs a capability that Rizq does not yet provide.
challenges.current_agent: Can generate a reviewed single-file code proposal with a local model after admin setup.
challenges.needed: Original POS source, multi-file changes, isolated validation, tests, review and controlled deployment.
challenges.success: An admin reviews a tested feature and enables it without breaking existing operations.

challenges.title: Forecast low stock and recommend replenishment
challenges.problem: Popular items run out or excess inventory is purchased.
challenges.current_agent: Can report on inventory and sales when the model calls the relevant tools.
challenges.needed: Forecasting rules, lead times, vendor information and reviewed recommendations.
challenges.success: Recommendations match historical test cases; an authorized person decides purchases.

challenges.title: Multi-branch offline synchronization
challenges.problem: Branches need consistent orders, products and inventory despite connectivity problems.
challenges.current_agent: May propose limited code changes; synchronization does not exist.
challenges.needed: Persistent server, identity, conflict handling, audit trail and recovery testing.
challenges.success: Disconnected branches reconcile without silently losing or duplicating transactions.
